requests.details: Floor 4 supply cabinet is out of printer paper, toner and sticky notes. Team has been borrowing supplies from other floors for two days.
New contractor starts Monday and needs a building access badge for Floor 2. Manager approval was sent yesterday but the badge office has not confirmed receipt.
Third-floor shared multifunction printer jams on every scan-to-email job. Sales proposals are being printed on the second floor instead.
Monthly cleaning contractor invoice for October is marked as a duplicate by accounts payable. Contractor has sent two reminders and threatened to pause service until payment is confirmed.
Video conferencing system in Boardroom B shows no audio. Board pre-read session is scheduled for tomorrow morning with two remote directors.
